Theorem
[Monotone Convergence Theorem] ↗ def:summable-function 1. appE:thm-4\group Measure Theory

Let $\{ f_k\} _{k=1}^\infty $ be measurable and satisfy \[ f_1\leq f_2\leq \cdots \leq f_k\leq f_{k+1}\leq \cdots . \] Then \[ \int _{\mathbb R^n}\lim _{k\to \infty }f_k\, dx =\lim _{k\to \infty }\int _{\mathbb R^n}f_k\, dx. \]
